title: Identifiers: protocol-06 MIMI URIs, email-style display
description: Wire: mimi://domain (provider), /u/user, /d/client (random per-device ID), /r/room, /g/group per protocol-06 Table 1. Client UI shows users as alice@a.example mapped to mimi://a.example/u/alice. Provider discovery via /.well-known/mimi-protocol-directory.
